# mabinogi-002 — establishment log (2026-11-11)

Evans 1907 cols 12 l. 25 – 19 l. 13 (PDF pp. 38–42), every column read on the page image (zoom 4; spot crops at zoom 10).
Base: Evans's letters as on the image; the second witness used only to locate disagreements and for punctuation shape
(the pilot's practice). 6-shaped w → w; r-rotunda → r; ſ → s; raised letters into the line; line-end marks, the
filler mark after "amser" (col 16 l. 27) and Evans's suspension/underline marks (Rof, heb, gwna, llaweñ) dropped.

## Worklist items (17 check + 10 loss), decided on the image
- col 13 l. 1 — "yr orssed" (r-rotunda + ſſ); OCR "ipf" is a misreading.
- col 13 l. 4 — "a'y kymriw": Evans prints k (witness "ymriw" is wrong).
- col 13 l. 13 — Evans prints **"a wnath"** (no e): a readable scribal slip for *a wnaeth*; kept. NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 13 l. 15 — "gwreic" (OCR "gíueic" misread).
- col 13 l. 24 — "A wyr" (6-shaped w).
- col 13 l. 34 — Evans prints **"mwyf"** for *mwyaf* ("A fei mwyf uei y urys ef"): slip kept. NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 14 l. 1 — **"idaw idaw"**: scribal dittography kept as written (setup decision). NOTE FOR DRAFTER.
- col 14 l. 17 — "Yr vn gerdet" (r-rotunda).
- col 14 l. 26 — Evans has the 6-shaped w: **"warch"** (witness "varch"); rule 6 → w applied. Soft-mutated *march* (object after the subject *i*). NOTE.
- col 15 l. 10 — "Yr orssed a gyrchyssant".
- col 15 l. 23 — "y makwyf" (witness "mukwyf" is a witness typo).
- col 15 l. 27 — Evans prints **"neir ry adoed"** (zoom-10 crop: clearly *neir*); witness "neu". Kept as written; probably a slip for *neur* (affirmative *neu* + infixed *'r*). Uncertain reading for the drafter to say so. NOTE.
- col 16 l. 3–4 — Evans prints **"no chynt bei ar y gam"**; the witness's "no chytl" is not in the White Book. Adopted Evans.
- col 16 l. 10 — Evans prints **"a wnaet"** (no h): slip for *a wnaeth*, kept. NOTE.
- col 16 l. 12 — Evans "Arglwyd heb [blank] allu": supplied **"nyt oes"** only, from the Red Book (setup decision); "ef" not supplied, so the text reads “Arglwyd,” heb, “nyt oes allu …”. NOTE FOR DRAFTER: say the words are supplied and that the speech-tag lacks *ef*.
- col 16 l. 27 — "amser mynet y wwyta": the OCR's "r"/"2" after *amser* is a filler mark; dropped. Evans prints **"wwyta"** (w + 6) — kept as written (witness agrees); slip for *uwyta*. NOTE.
- col 17 l. 4 — "Dyuot y'r orssed" (motion: y + 'r).
- col 17 l. 7 — "welynt" (6-shaped w).
- col 17 l. 26 — "A uorwyn".
- col 17 l. 32 — "y uorwyn".
- col 18 l. 10 — "uorwyn".
- col 18 l. 17 — Evans prints **"heb y pwll"** (no y): slip for *Pwyll*, kept as "Pwll". NOTE.
- col 19 l. 8 — "Yn llawen" (ñ suspension mark dropped, as the conventions drop Evans's marks).
- col 19 l. 12 — raised c after a: "ac e ymdeith".

## Other decisions
- Opening: "Athreigyl|gueith" — plain A, no large initial; divided "A threigylgueith" as the pilot does.
- "priflys" divided "prif lys", as the pilot.
- "ohonawch i" — Evans spaces it; kept spaced (witness "ohonawchi").
- "yr un ford" / "yr vn ford" kept as the article (*yr*), not *y'r* — ambiguous; the drafter may read *y'r* 'by the'.
- "pei ass archut" — Evans "affarchut" divided as the witness does (infixed *-s* 'it', doubled).
- Paragraphs: five scene changes (first sighting; next morning; second sighting; third morning; third sighting and
  the meeting), and the meeting with Rhiannon set off as a sixth.
